from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from fastapi import WebSocket


class RealtimeHub:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._operators: set[WebSocket] = set()
        self._clients: dict[str, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def add_operator(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self._operators.add(websocket)

    async def add_client(self, shipment_id: str, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self._clients[shipment_id].add(websocket)

    async def remove(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self._operators.discard(websocket)
            for sockets in self._clients.values():
                sockets.discard(websocket)

    async def publish(self, event: str, payload: dict[str, Any], shipment_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        message = {"event": event, "payload": payload}
        targets = set(self._operators)
        if shipment_id:
            targets.update(self._clients.get(shipment_id, set()))
        stale: list[WebSocket] = []
        for socket in targets:
            try:
                await socket.send_json(message)
            except Exception:
                stale.append(socket)
        for socket in stale:
            await self.remove(socket)


hub = RealtimeHub()

}


def airports_for(city: str, country: str) -> list[Airport]:
    normalized = CITY_ALIASES.get(city.strip().lower(), city.strip().lower())
    exact = [a for a in AIRPORTS if a.country == country.upper() and a.city_ru.lower() == normalized]
    return exact or [a for a in AIRPORTS if a.country == country.upper()]

from __future__ import annotations

from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, model_validator


class DeliveryMode(StrEnum):
    DOOR_TO_DOOR = "door_to_door"
    DOOR_TO_AIRPORT = "door_to_airport"
    AIRPORT_TO_AIRPORT = "airport_to_airport"
    AIRPORT_TO_DOOR = "airport_to_door"


class Tariff(StrEnum):
    ECONOMY = "economy"
    STANDARD = "standard"
    EXPRESS = "express"
    CHARTER = "charter"


class ShipmentStatus(StrEnum):
    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
    ANALYZING = "analyzing"
    NEEDS_REVIEW = "needs_review"
    QUOTE_DRAFT = "quote_draft"
    QUOTE_SENT = "quote_sent"
    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
    AWAITING_CARGO = "awaiting_cargo"
    WAREHOUSE_RECEIVED = "warehouse_received"
    CUSTOMS_PROCESSING = "customs_processing"
    READY_FOR_DEPARTURE = "ready_for_departure"
    HANDED_TO_CARRIER = "handed_to_carrier"
    DEPARTED = "departed"
    ARRIVED = "arrived"
    LAST_MILE = "last_mile"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class LocationInput(BaseModel):
    address: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=300)
    city: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=100)
    country: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=2)
    latitude: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=-90, le=90)
    longitude: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=-180, le=180)

    @field_validator("country")
    @classmethod
    def normalize_country(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return value.upper()


class CargoInput(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=160)
    description: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=1500)
    pieces: int = Field(ge=1, le=10000)
    weight_kg: float = Field(gt=0, le=500000)
    length_cm: float = Field(gt=0, le=5000)
    width_cm: float = Field(gt=0, le=5000)
    height_cm: float = Field(gt=0, le=5000)
    declared_value: float = Field(ge=0, le=1_000_000_000)
    declared_currency: Literal["RUB", "USD", "EUR", "CNY", "TJS", "KGS", "KZT", "UZS"]
    features: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)


class ShipmentCreate(BaseModel):
    delivery_mode: DeliveryMode
    tariff: Tariff
    origin: LocationInput
    destination: LocationInput
    cargo: CargoInput
    client_name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    client_phone: str = Field(min_length=5, max_length=40)
    client_email: str = Field(default="", max_length=160)
    product_photo_ids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8)
    packaging_photo_ids: list[str] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8)


class ImageUpload(BaseModel):
    filename: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=160)
    mime_type: Literal["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"]
    data_base64: str = Field(min_length=20)


class OperatorLogin(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(default="", max_length=254)
    password: str = Field(min_length=6, max_length=200)


class QuoteOptionSend(BaseModel):
    tariff: Literal["flex", "standard", "priority", "charter"]
    title: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=80)
    amount: float = Field(gt=0, le=1_000_000_000)
    currency: Literal["RUB", "USD", "EUR", "CNY", "TJS", "KGS", "KZT", "UZS"]
    eta_min_hours: int = Field(gt=0, le=24 * 90)
    eta_max_hours: int = Field(gt=0, le=24 * 120)
    route_summary: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=300)
    conditions: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    source_reference: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    source_confidence: Literal["operator_verified", "partner_confirmed"]
    recommended: bool = False

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_eta(self) -> "QuoteOptionSend":
        if self.eta_max_hours < self.eta_min_hours:
            raise ValueError("Максимальный срок не может быть меньше минимального")
        return self


class QuoteBundleSend(BaseModel):
    options: list[QuoteOptionSend] = Field(min_length=2, max_length=4)
    expires_at: str
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_bundle(self) -> "QuoteBundleSend":
        tariffs = [option.tariff for option in self.options]
        if len(set(tariffs)) != len(tariffs):
            raise ValueError("В пакете не должно быть повторяющихся тарифов")
        if len({option.currency for option in self.options}) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Все варианты пакета должны быть в одной валюте")
        if sum(option.recommended for option in self.options) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Ровно один вариант должен быть рекомендован")
        return self


class QuoteAccept(BaseModel):
    option_id: str = Field(min_length=20, max_length=80)


class StatusChange(BaseModel):
    status: ShipmentStatus
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)


class CapacityOfferCreate(BaseModel):
    carrier: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    flight: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=50)
    departure: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=4)
    destination: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=4)
    departure_at: str
    cutoff_at: str
    available_kg: float = Field(gt=0)
    available_m3: float = Field(gt=0)
    rate_per_kg: float = Field(gt=0)
    minimum_charge: float = Field(ge=0)
    currency: Literal["RUB", "USD", "EUR", "CNY", "TJS", "KGS", "KZT", "UZS"]
    allowed_categories: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ["general_cargo"])
    restrictions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    valid_until: str
    source_reference: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    confidence: Literal["operator_verified", "partner_confirmed"]

"""ASGI bridge that runs SkySeal OS inside Pyodide for the static browser demo.

The JavaScript host (demo/worker.js) calls `start()`, then `http()` for each
API request and `ws_*()` for realtime sockets. The FastAPI app itself is the
unchanged `skyseal.main.app`; this module only speaks ASGI to it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from typing import Any, Callable


def _no_threads() -> None:
    """Pyodide cannot start threads: run sync endpoints and dependencies inline."""
    import anyio.to_thread

    async def run_sync(func: Callable[..., Any], *args: Any, **_: Any) -> Any:
        return func(*args)

    anyio.to_thread.run_sync = run_sync  # type: ignore[assignment]


_no_threads()

from skyseal.main import app  # noqa: E402  (after the thread patch)

_lifespan_queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue()
_sockets: dict[str, asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
_tasks: set[asyncio.Task[Any]] = set()


def _keep(task: asyncio.Task[Any]) -> asyncio.Task[Any]:
    _tasks.add(task)
    task.add_done_callback(_tasks.discard)
    return task


async def start() -> None:
    """Run the app's lifespan startup (settings check, database schema)."""
    ready: asyncio.Future[None] = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
    _lifespan_queue.put_nowait({"type": "lifespan.startup"})

    async def receive() -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await _lifespan_queue.get()

    async def send(message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if message["type"] == "lifespan.startup.complete" and not ready.done():
            ready.set_result(None)
        elif message["type"] == "lifespan.startup.failed" and not ready.done():
            ready.set_exception(RuntimeError(message.get("message", "startup failed")))

    _keep(asyncio.ensure_future(app({"type": "lifespan", "asgi": {"version": "3.0"}, "state": {}}, receive, send)))
    await ready


def _scope(kind: str, path: str, query: str, headers: list[list[str]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "type": kind,
        "asgi": {"version": "3.0"},
        "http_version": "1.1",
        "scheme": "https" if kind == "http" else "wss",
        "path": path,
        "raw_path": path.encode(),
        "root_path": "",
        "query_string": query.encode(),
        "headers": [(k.lower().encode("latin-1"), v.encode("latin-1")) for k, v in headers],
        "client": ("127.0.0.1", 0),
        "server": ("skyseal-demo", 443),
        "state": {},
    }


async def http(method: str, path: str, query: str, headers: list[list[str]], body: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """One HTTP request. Resolves with the response as soon as the body is
    complete; background tasks (the agent pipeline) keep running afterwards."""
    scope = _scope("http", path, query, headers)
    scope["method"] = method.upper()
    done: asyncio.Future[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
    response: dict[str, Any] = {"status": 500, "headers": [], "body": b""}
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    sent_body = False

    async def receive() -> dict[str, Any]:
        nonlocal sent_body
        if not sent_body:
            sent_body = True
            return {"type": "http.request", "body": bytes(body), "more_body": False}
        await asyncio.Event().wait()  # disconnect never comes
        return {"type": "http.disconnect"}

    async def send(message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
            response["status"] = message["status"]
            response["headers"] = [[k.decode("latin-1"), v.decode("latin-1")] for k, v in message.get("headers", [])]
        elif message["type"] == "http.response.body":
            chunks.append(message.get("body", b""))
            if not message.get("more_body") and not done.done():
                response["body"] = b"".join(chunks)
                done.set_result(response)

    task = _keep(asyncio.ensure_future(app(scope, receive, send)))

    def failed(t: asyncio.Task[Any]) -> None:
        if not done.done():
            exc = t.exception() if not t.cancelled() else None
            done.set_exception(exc or RuntimeError("request cancelled"))

    task.add_done_callback(failed)
    return await done


def ws_open(conn_id: str, path: str, query: str, headers: list[list[str]], emit: Callable[[str, str, Any], None]) -> None:
    """Open a websocket; `emit(conn_id, kind, data)` gets accept/text/close."""
    inbox: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue()
    inbox.put_nowait({"type": "websocket.connect"})
    _sockets[conn_id] = inbox
    scope = _scope("websocket", path, query, headers)
    scope["subprotocols"] = []

    async def receive() -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await inbox.get()

    async def send(message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        kind = message["type"]
        if kind == "websocket.accept":
            emit(conn_id, "open", None)
        elif kind == "websocket.send":
            emit(conn_id, "message", message.get("text") if message.get("text") is not None else message.get("bytes", b"").decode())
        elif kind == "websocket.close":
            _sockets.pop(conn_id, None)
            emit(conn_id, "close", message.get("code", 1000))

    async def run() -> None:
        try:
            await app(scope, receive, send)
        finally:
            if _sockets.pop(conn_id, None) is not None:
                emit(conn_id, "close", 1006)

    _keep(asyncio.ensure_future(run()))


def ws_send(conn_id: str, text: str) -> None:
    inbox = _sockets.get(conn_id)
    if inbox:
        inbox.put_nowait({"type": "websocket.receive", "text": text})


def ws_close(conn_id: str) -> None:
    inbox = _sockets.get(conn_id)
    if inbox:
        inbox.put_nowait({"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000})
